sources.paraphrase: Schema-element matching uses actual substitution membership, excludes abstract declarations and observes blocking constraints, candidate typing and nillability. Schema-element subtyping is based on actual member-set containment; function parameter types are contravariant.
The substitutionGroup attribute can contain a list of QNames in XSD 1.1, requiring affiliation-list component and substitution semantics.
The .NET property is a single XmlQualifiedName; the framework probe independently records its runtime type and failure during addition of the unchanged multi-affiliation schema.
